area: the Profile's colour-set rail and its catalog
summary: Four sets join the Profile's colour-set rail after Nacre: Blue-ringed Octopus, Neon Noir, Ukiyo-e and Dusk, the /colour-set skill's worked examples, now game sets (free track, unlocked like every set). author_colour_set_catalog.py SETS gained their four rows; ColorSetCatalog.asset gained four entries whose words are seeded and editable in the inspector; the editor themes (FrogletSeaTheme.Themes.cs) and the console's themes.css/theme.js were regenerated from the catalog.
why: Garrett: the artifact lab had some great new color sets (like dusk and neon noir); i just tried bleeding edge and they were not there
